config.shadowdrop.title: Shadow Drop Config
config.shadowdrop.modEnabled.tooltip: Enable or disable drop shadows entirely.
config.shadowdrop.shadowColor.tooltip: The color of the shadow as an RGB hex string (e.g., #000000).
config.shadowdrop.shadowAlpha.tooltip: Opacity of the shadow (0 is fully transparent, 255 is fully opaque).
config.shadowdrop.offsetItems.tooltip: Slightly pushes items forward so that shadows render properly behind them.
config.shadowdrop.shadowsAlways.tooltip: Forces shadows to be rendered in all contexts (overrules individual options).
config.shadowdrop.shadowsInSlots.tooltip: Renders shadows under items within standard GUI slots.
config.shadowdrop.shadowsInHotbar.toolti: Renders shadows under items in the hotbar.
config.shadowdrop.shadowsInCursor.toolti: Renders shadows under the item currently carried by your mouse cursor.
config.shadowdrop.cropToSlots.tooltip: Constrains slot shadows to the slot borders.
config.shadowdrop.cropToHotbar.tooltip: Constrains hotbar shadows to the hotbar slots.
config.shadowdrop.uncropUnderCursor.tool: Keeps shadows uncropped when items are hovered.
config.shadowdrop.slotBrColors.tooltip: HEX color(s) of the slot's bottom-right pixel, used to detect slots (comma-separated).
config.shadowdrop.translucentItems.toolt: Items/tags that render shadows with 50% opacity (comma-separated).
config.shadowdrop.forceDepthRefresh.tool: Forces a depth buffer refresh. Fixes overlap issues but might cause rendering bugs.
